blocks.en: A mission is a task offered by a non-player character (NPC) to a player that requires the player to accomplish a set of objectives in exchange for a set of rewards. Such NPCs are called agents and they describe the task and specify the rewards for its completion.
blocks.zh: 任务是由非玩家角色（NPC）发布给玩家的工作，玩家需要完成一系列目标来换取一系列奖励。这类 NPC 被称为代理人，他们会说明任务内容，并给出完成后的奖励。

blocks.en: Mission levels
blocks.zh: 任务等级

blocks.en: Mission levels go from 1 to 5. Higher level missions generally requires that you have better skills and access to bigger ships. Higher level missions also increase rewards. A mission's level is identical to the offering agents level with the exception of Storyline missions. As your corporation and faction standings increase, you'll gain access to higher level agents and thus missions.
blocks.zh: 任务等级从 1 到 5。等级越高的任务通常要求更好的技能和更大的舰船，奖励也越高。除剧情任务外，任务等级与发布任务的代理人等级相同。随着你对军团和势力的声望提高，你就能接触到更高等级的代理人，从而接到更高等级的任务。

en: Level 1: The most basic type. Can be run by basic frigates. Only the most basic piloting skills are required.
Level 2: While Mining and Courier missions may be run in frigates, Encounter is designed for cruiser hulls. You are expected to improve your abilities and learn how to fit out new ships.

Level 3: As you specialize, you will need a battlecruiser, Mining Barge, or a medium-sized hauler; mining destroyers can also be used for select mining missions. These missions go faster if you have trained for better ships and at least some Tech 2 fittings. This is the highest mission level to be available for Alpha clones.
Level 4: These require a battleship, an exhumer, or a large hauler. These missions can be time-consuming, but they offer large rewards. These missions require Omega to run.
Level 5: Mostly encounter (combat) missions designed for groups of players or capital ships and are exclusively located in Low Security space. Like level 4, these also require Omega to run.
zh: 1 级：最基础的任务。用基础的护卫舰就能完成，只需要最基本的驾驶技能。
2 级：采矿和运输任务仍可用护卫舰完成，但遭遇战任务是按巡洋舰船体设计的。你需要提升自己的能力，并学会给新船装配。
3 级：随着你走向专精，你会需要战列巡洋舰、采矿驳船或中型运载舰；部分采矿任务也可以用采矿驱逐舰完成。如果你已经练出更好的舰船，并且至少有一些T2装备，这些任务会完成得更快。这是 Alpha 克隆能接到的最高任务等级。
4 级：需要战列舰、采掘者或大型运载舰。这些任务可能比较耗时，但奖励丰厚。需要 Omega 才能执行。
5 级：大多是为多人小队或旗舰设计的遭遇战（战斗）任务，而且只在低安出现。和 4 级一样，也需要 Omega 才能执行。

blocks.en: Mission types
blocks.zh: 任务类型

blocks.en: Mission type is an in-game parameter that can be found in the mission journal.
blocks.zh: 任务类型是游戏内的一个参数，可以在任务日志中查看。

blocks.en: With the Viridian expansion the mission journal was removed from the Neocom and the short-cut settings. Its keyboard short-cut was assigned to the newly introduced opportunities window.
blocks.zh: 在Viridian版本中，任务日志被从Neocom和快捷键设置中移除，原来的快捷键分配给了新加入的机遇（Opportunities）窗口。

blocks.en: Till the 2nd December 2025, the mission journal could still be called using the slash command /open journal in any of the chat windows.
blocks.zh: 在 2025 年 12 月 2 日之前，仍然可以在任意聊天窗口中用斜杠命令 /open journal 打开任务日志。

blocks.en: In the Version 23.02 release 2025-12-02.1 CCP announced: Slash commands via chat have been disabled.
blocks.zh: 在 23.02 版本 2025-12-02.1 更新中，CCP 宣布：聊天中的斜杠命令已被禁用。

blocks.en: Courier missions (also referred to as distribution) require shipping cargo from station to station. Courier missions have no inherent combat. Courier missions are the fastest mission type to run so they are sometimes used for fast standings gains. Courier missions produce a warning when trying to leave the pick-up station without the required cargo in your hold.
blocks.zh: 运输任务（也叫物流任务）要求把货物从一个空间站运到另一个空间站。运输任务本身不包含战斗。它是完成速度最快的任务类型，因此有时被用来快速刷声望。如果你在货舱里没有所需货物的情况下试图离开取货空间站，游戏会给出警告。

blocks.en: Mining missions require you to mine a specific mission ore and bring it back to the agent's station. Level 1 and 2 mining missions have no inherent combat. There is however always a risk of combat during mining missions, through the "belt rat" NPC hostiles that can show up and are usually rather weak. Note that mission ore except Lyavite has no other uses and can not be traded on the market.
blocks.zh: 采矿任务要求你开采指定的任务矿石并带回代理人所在的空间站。1 级和 2 级采矿任务本身不包含战斗。不过采矿任务中始终存在战斗风险，可能会刷出“矿带怪”这类敌对 NPC，它们通常比较弱。注意，除拉尔乏水硼砂外，任务矿石没有其他用途，也不能在市场上交易。

blocks.en: Trade missions involve an agent requesting a specific item to "trade" for the reward. Trade missions have no inherent combat of itself. Trade missions do not occur as basic missions but show up as Storyline and COSMOS missions. The item(s) to trade can often be bought of the market or in contracts but you can also acquire them yourself which might require mining or combat.
blocks.zh: 交易任务是代理人要求你提供某件指定物品来“交换”奖励。交易任务本身不包含战斗。它不会作为基础任务出现，而是以剧情任务和 COSMOS 任务的形式出现。所需物品通常可以在市场或合同中买到，也可以自己获取，这可能需要采矿或战斗。

blocks.en: Talk to Agent missions (also referred to as travel) require you to report to another agent. Initiating communication with that agent completes the mission. These missions occur as part of Epic Arcs.
blocks.zh: 与代理人对话任务（也叫旅行任务）要求你去找另一位代理人报到，与该代理人开始对话即完成任务。这类任务出现在史诗任务线中。

blocks.en: Agent Interaction missions (also referred to as branch) require you to choose one mission from a set of 2 or more missions. Confirming your choice completes the interaction mission and accepts the mission of your choice. These missions occur as part of Epic Arcs.
blocks.zh: 代理人互动任务（也叫分支任务）要求你从 2 个或更多任务中选择一个。确认选择后即完成该互动任务，并接下你所选的任务。这类任务出现在史诗任务线中。

blocks.en: Encounter missions are all other missions which are mostly combat-focused. The job is usually to kill pirates, retrieve stolen goods, or destroy strategic targets. But sometimes it is doing a recon (i.e. go to the target area, look and leave) or transporting items from or to a structure (not a station) somewhere in space. Unlike "true" courier missions encounter transport missions will not warn you when you try to leave the pick-up location without the cargo in your hold. These missions have the highest rewards but they are also slower and involve a risk of dying.
blocks.zh: 遭遇战任务是其余所有任务，大多以战斗为主。通常是击杀海盗、夺回被盗物品或摧毁战略目标。但有时也是侦察（即前往目标区域看一眼就离开），或者在太空中某个建筑（不是空间站）之间运送物品。与“真正的”运输任务不同，遭遇战中的运输任务在你货舱里没有货物就试图离开取货地点时不会警告你。这类任务奖励最高，但耗时更长，也有阵亡的风险。

blocks.en: Mission categories
blocks.zh: 任务分类

blocks.en: Basic missions
blocks.zh: 基础任务

blocks.en: Basic missions are offered by regular agents and are of the types: Courier, Mining or Encounter. Basic missions are randomly allocated out of a pool except for the missions in a mission chain.
blocks.zh: 基础任务由普通代理人发布，类型为运输、采矿或遭遇战。除任务链中的任务外，基础任务都是从任务池中随机分配的。

blocks.en: Storyline missions
blocks.zh: 剧情任务

blocks.en: As you continue to complete missions, you will occasionally get a Storyline Mission offer from a special Storyline agent. The game tracks how many missions you've completed for each combination of level and faction. For every 16 missions of the same level and faction (but not necessarily the same corporation) that you complete, you will get a new Storyline mission offer from the nearest Storyline agent of the same faction. This will always be the Storyline agent closest (in terms of number of jumps) to the regular agent who gave you your 16th mission with two exceptions:
blocks.zh: 随着你不断完成任务，偶尔会收到特殊剧情代理人发来的剧情任务邀请。游戏会按等级和势力的组合分别统计你完成的任务数。每完成 16 个同等级、同势力（不必是同一军团）的任务，你就会收到同势力最近一位剧情代理人发来的新剧情任务邀请。这位剧情代理人总是距离发布第 16 个任务的普通代理人（按跳数计算）最近的那一位，但有两种例外：

en: If the closest Storyline Agent has already made you an offer that you haven't accepted or declined, then it will be the second-closest Storyline agent that you get the offer from.
If the agent who gave you the 16th regular mission that you completed was in High Security, then the Storyline offer will always come from a Storyline agent in High Security.
zh: 如果最近的剧情代理人已经向你发出过邀请，而你尚未接受或拒绝，那么邀请会来自第二近的剧情代理人。
如果发布你第 16 个普通任务的代理人位于高安，那么剧情任务邀请一定来自位于高安的剧情代理人。

blocks.en: The Storyline agent will contact you from a station - you will get a notification about an important mission offer - however, you will need to travel to the agent's station to accept the mission. Once you are in touch with the Storyline agent, you accept and complete the mission in the usual way. You cannot work for a Storyline agent unless you've received an offer from that Agent.
blocks.zh: 剧情代理人会从某个空间站联系你——你会收到一条重要任务邀请的通知——但你需要前往该代理人所在的空间站才能接受任务。联系上剧情代理人后，按通常方式接受和完成任务即可。没有收到某位剧情代理人的邀请，就无法为其工作。

blocks.en: Completing a Storyline mission gives large increases to your standing with the agent's corporation and a moderate increase to faction standing. Note that you will also get derived standings, both positive and negative, towards other factions. If you keep doing Storyline missions for Minmatar Republic you will find that Gallente Federation will also like you while Amarr Empire, Caldari State and various pirate factions will gradually start to dislike you.
blocks.zh: 完成剧情任务会大幅提升你对代理人所属军团的声望，并适度提升对其势力的声望。注意，你还会获得对其他势力的连带声望变化，有正面的，也有负面的。如果你一直为米玛塔尔共和国做剧情任务，你会发现盖伦特联邦也会喜欢你，而艾玛帝国、加达里合众国和各个海盗势力会逐渐开始讨厌你。

blocks.en: When trying to increase standings with a particular NPC corporation, it is possible to plan your missioning in a way that when you hand in your 16th mission, you get your offer from the Storyline agent of the corporation that you are focusing on.
blocks.zh: 如果你想提升对某个 NPC 军团的声望，可以合理规划任务，让你在交第 16 个任务时，刚好收到你主攻的那个军团的剧情代理人发来的邀请。

blocks.en: Storyline missions are of the types courier, encounter, or trade. There is no relation between the mission type and the issuing Storyline agent's division.
blocks.zh: 剧情任务的类型为运输、遭遇战或交易。任务类型与发布任务的剧情代理人所属部门无关。

blocks.en: The storyline mission level is equal to the level of the mission set for which it is offered. Not the agent level as all storyline agents are level 1 for accessibility.
blocks.zh: 剧情任务的等级等于触发它的那组任务的等级，而不是代理人等级——为了方便所有人接取，所有剧情代理人都是 1 级。

blocks.en: The InterBus and militia corporations do not offer any Storyline missions.
blocks.zh: 星捷运和民兵军团不提供任何剧情任务。

blocks.en: Special missions
blocks.zh: 特殊任务

blocks.en: These mission types are not regularly available and are bound by conditions you need to fulfill before they are offered to you.
blocks.zh: 这些任务类型并非随时都能接到，需要先满足一定条件才会向你提供。

blocks.en: Career missions
blocks.zh: 生涯任务

blocks.en: Main article: Career Agents
blocks.zh: 主条目：生涯代理人

blocks.en: Career missions, also known as "tutorial missions", are missions that are supposed to help teach players how to play EVE Online. It is a good idea to do these when you first start playing EVE, as they give you starter ships and equipment. They also increase your standings with the faction offering the missions. Each player character can only do each tutorial mission from a given career agent once, but the career agent mission chains do count as Storyline missions and thus increase faction standings after completing a full set; however, as of 25 February 2026 they do not cause derived standings anymore.
blocks.zh: 生涯任务也叫“教程任务”，用来帮助玩家学习如何玩 EVE Online。刚开始玩 EVE 时最好做一做这些任务，因为它们会送你新手舰船和装备，还能提升你对发布任务的势力的声望。每个角色对同一位生涯代理人的每个教程任务只能做一次，但生涯代理人的任务链算作剧情任务，因此完成整套后会提升势力声望；不过从 2026 年 2 月 25 日起，它们不再产生连带声望变化。

blocks.en: Research missions
blocks.zh: 研究任务

blocks.en: Main article: Research missions
blocks.zh: 主条目：研究任务

blocks.en: Research missions are a part of the Industry career path. Instead of ISK and Loyalty Points, these missions award Research Points that can be used to buy datacores from the agent who gives the missions. You will need to have trained various Science skills to the level required by an agent before they will offer you a mission. Datacores can be sold at the Market, and some players run these missions to make ISK from trading - do keep in mind that the income is quite low. Most players, however, have not trained the Science skills that these missions require. Research missions do count for the storyline mission tally.
blocks.zh: 研究任务属于工业职业路线。这类任务不奖励 ISK 和忠诚点，而是奖励研究点数，可以用来向发布任务的代理人购买数据核心。你需要把各项科学类技能练到代理人要求的等级，代理人才会向你提供任务。数据核心可以在市场上出售，有些玩家做这类任务就是为了靠交易赚 ISK——但要注意收入相当低。不过大多数玩家都没有练这些任务所需的科学类技能。研究任务会计入剧情任务的统计次数。

blocks.en: Epic arcs
blocks.zh: 史诗任务线

blocks.en: Main article: Epic arcs
blocks.zh: 主条目：史诗任务线

blocks.en: Epic arcs are long series of missions. Throughout the arc, you will be offered choices that will branch the arc into one or more directions, and thus the arcs have different outcomes depending on your choices. The missions that make up these arcs typically have very good ISK rewards and the last mission of the arc carries a handsome reward. They also tend to be quite a degree more difficult than normal missions of the same level. There are seven Epic Arcs. Most players begin with The Blood-Stained Stars, an arc that can be completed in a T1 destroyer and gives a boost in standings with the Sisters of EVE and one empire faction of your choice. Seasoned L4 runners will be doing the four empire epic arcs while the fearless pilots can do the two pirate epic arcs. Epic arcs can be repeated once every three months. Epic arc missions do not give Loyalty points. Epic arc missions do count for the storyline mission tally.
blocks.zh: 史诗任务线是一长串连续的任务。在任务线中你会面临若干选择，任务线会因此分出一个或多个方向，结局也会随你的选择而不同。组成这些任务线的任务通常 ISK 奖励很高，最后一个任务更是奖励丰厚。它们的难度通常也比同等级的普通任务高不少。史诗任务线共有七条。大多数玩家会从血染星空（The Blood-Stained Stars）开始，这条任务线用 T1 驱逐舰就能完成，并能提升你对姐妹会以及你所选的一个帝国势力的声望。经验丰富的 4 级任务玩家会去做四条帝国史诗任务线，而无所畏惧的飞行员可以挑战两条海盗史诗任务线。史诗任务线每三个月可以重复一次。史诗任务线的任务不给忠诚点，但会计入剧情任务的统计次数。

blocks.en: Anomic missions
blocks.zh: 异常任务

blocks.en: Main article: Anomic missions
blocks.zh: 主条目：异常任务（Anomic missions）

blocks.en: Anomic missions also known as "burner" missions, are optional Security missions that are offered by level 4 agents. They can always be declined without penalty. Anomic missions present a more difficult challenge compared to other Security missions. You will encounter a small number of very powerful adversaries and you are restricted in ship size. These missions require specialized and expensive ship fits and high skills to solo. They also require piloting skills that are otherwise rarely used in PvE such as overheating.
blocks.zh: 异常任务也叫“燃烧者（burner）”任务，是由 4 级代理人提供的可选安全任务，随时可以拒绝而不受惩罚。与其他安全任务相比，异常任务的挑战更大。你会遇到少量非常强大的敌人，而且对舰船尺寸有限制。想要单刷这些任务，需要专门的高价装配和很高的技能，还需要掌握在 PvE 中很少用到的驾驶技巧，比如超载。

blocks.en: COSMOS
blocks.zh: COSMOS

blocks.en: Main article: COSMOS
blocks.zh: 主条目：COSMOS

blocks.en: COSMOS missions are special missions found in certain regions of space. These missions vary wildly in difficulty from easy L1 to harder-than-usual L4. Unlike normal missions these missions require faction standings to accept. The COSMOS missions are offered only once and can not be repeated. If you let them expire or fail them they will not be offered to you again and the following missions will not be offered to you. COSMOS missions do not reward loyalty points.
blocks.zh: COSMOS 任务是出现在特定星域中的特殊任务。难度差别极大，从简单的 1 级到比一般更难的 4 级都有。与普通任务不同，接取这些任务需要势力声望。COSMOS 任务只提供一次，不可重复。如果让它过期或任务失败，就不会再向你提供，后续任务也不会再提供。COSMOS 任务不奖励忠诚点。

blocks.en: Data center
blocks.zh: 数据中心

blocks.en: Main article: Data centers
blocks.zh: 主条目：数据中心

blocks.en: Involve handing in tags to the agent for standing gains. This effectively allows you to buy faction standings. Note though that each data center mission can be done only once.
blocks.zh: 向代理人上交身份标签来换取声望，相当于可以花钱买势力声望。但要注意，每个数据中心任务只能做一次。

blocks.en: Mission chain
blocks.zh: 任务链

blocks.en: A mission chain is a series of connected missions. Completing a mission will automatically offer the next mission in the chain. Some mission chains share a single offer timer. Chain missions can be of a different type than is usual for the agent's division. Mission chains can usually be identified by some form of "part x of y" in the title of the mission but not always (see the mission chain Survey Rendezvous, Listening Post and Kicking the Nest for an example).
blocks.zh: 任务链是一系列相互关联的任务。完成一个任务后，会自动提供链中的下一个任务。有些任务链共用同一个邀请计时器。链中任务的类型可能与代理人所属部门的常规类型不同。任务链通常可以通过任务标题中类似“第 x 部分，共 y 部分”的字样来识别，但并非总是如此（例如任务链Survey Rendezvous、Listening Post和Kicking the Nest）。

blocks.en: Rewards
blocks.zh: 奖励

blocks.en: Completing missions will reward you with ISK, loyalty points, standings and occasionally with items.
blocks.zh: 完成任务会奖励 ISK、忠诚点、声望，偶尔还有物品。

blocks.en: The amount of ISK received is influenced by the Negotiation skill giving 5% additional ISK per skill level.
blocks.zh: 获得的 ISK 数量受谈判技巧技能影响，每级额外增加 5% ISK。

blocks.en: Loyalty points
blocks.zh: 忠诚点

blocks.en: Being paid with ISK is clear-cut, however, new missioneers often forget about loyalty points(LP) they gain whilst running missions. Loyalty points are a currency that you receive from the corporation whose agent gives you a mission. These points can be used to buy things at the corporation's store. LP (plus a certain amount of ISK and/or particular items) can be exchanged for valuable items in the LP store of the mission agent's corporation. For some players, it is more profitable to accumulate LP to exchange them for goods that can then be sold than it is to kill, loot, and salvage in encounter missions. The mission LP rewards scale with the system security of the agent and the level of the "Division" Connections skill. The formula for calculating the LP reward is:
blocks.zh: ISK 报酬一目了然，但新手任务玩家常常忘了做任务时获得的忠诚点（LP）。忠诚点是一种货币，由发布任务的代理人所属军团发放，可以在该军团的商店里购买物品。LP（加上一定数量的 ISK 和/或特定物品）可以在任务代理人所属军团的 LP 商店里兑换有价值的物品。对有些玩家来说，攒 LP 换取物品再卖掉，比在遭遇战任务中击杀、拾取和打捞更赚钱。任务的 LP 奖励随代理人所在星系的安全等级和对应“部门”关系学技能的等级而变化。LP 奖励的计算公式为：

blocks.en: LP reward=Base LP×(1.6288−System security)×(1+Division Connections×0.1)
blocks.zh: LP 奖励=基础 LP×(1.6288−星系安全等级)×(1+部门关系学技能等级×0.1)

blocks.en: This means that an agent in a 0.5 security system pays 80% more than an agent in 1.0 security system. Note that the system security used here is the true security of the system.
blocks.zh: 也就是说，位于 0.5 安全等级星系的代理人比位于 1.0 星系的代理人多给 80%。注意这里用的是星系的真实安全等级。

blocks.en: The "Division" Connections skills are:
blocks.zh: “部门”关系学技能包括：

en: Distribution Connections - Improves loyalty point gain by 10% per level when working for agents in the Distribution division.
Mining Connections - Improves loyalty point gain by 10% per level when working for agents in the Mining division.
Security Connections - Improves loyalty point gain by 10% per level when working for agents in the Security division.
zh: 物流关系学 - 为物流部门的代理人工作时，每级提高 10% 忠诚点收益。
采矿关系学 - 为采矿部门的代理人工作时，每级提高 10% 忠诚点收益。
安全关系学 - 为安全部门的代理人工作时，每级提高 10% 忠诚点收益。

blocks.en: The rewards are also dynamically adjusted based on past completion data. This dynamic calculation affects ISK/LP payout, bonus reward, and timed bonus reward.
blocks.zh: 奖励还会根据过往的完成数据动态调整。这种动态计算会影响 ISK/LP 报酬、额外奖励和限时额外奖励。

blocks.en: Standings
blocks.zh: 声望

blocks.en: When you complete a regular mission for an agent, you get increased standings with the agent and the corporation, but not the faction. It is worth noting that if the mission involves destroying ships or structures of a different faction, your standings with the target faction will go down due to a "Combat - Ship Kill" malus. Those who wish to be able to fly in all of High Security space are advised to decline all anti-Empire missions (that is, anti-Amarr, anti-Ammatar, anti-Caldari, anti-Gallente, anti-Minmatar and anti-CONCORD). Some exceptions or workarounds exist; for example, a Minmatar agent might give you the mission Friendly Spies, where if you destroy the mission objective but none of the hostile ships you won't lose Gallente Federation standings. In other cases, the standing losses due to "Combat - Ship Kill" are almost insignificant, such as Amarrian Tyrants (Level 3). However, some missions will incur -2.4% standing losses for ship kills and might require one or more completed storyline missions for the opposing side to repair the standings losses.
blocks.zh: 为代理人完成普通任务时，你对该代理人和其所属军团的声望会提升，但势力声望不会。值得注意的是，如果任务要求摧毁其他势力的舰船或建筑，你对目标势力的声望会因“战斗 - 击毁舰船”惩罚而下降。想在所有高安区域畅行的玩家，建议拒绝所有针对帝国的任务（即针对艾玛、艾玛达、加达里、盖伦特、米玛塔尔和统合部的任务）。也有一些例外或变通办法：比如米玛塔尔代理人可能给你Friendly Spies任务，只要你摧毁任务目标而不击毁任何敌对舰船，就不会损失盖伦特联邦声望。另一些情况下，“战斗 - 击毁舰船”造成的声望损失几乎可以忽略，比如Amarrian Tyrants（3 级）。不过，有些任务击毁舰船会造成 -2.4% 的声望损失，可能需要为对立一方完成一个或多个剧情任务才能把损失补回来。

blocks.en: Accepting, and then quitting a level 4 mission will result -6.2% agent, -2.5% corporation and about -0.1% faction standing loss.
blocks.zh: 接受后又放弃一个 4 级任务，会导致代理人声望 -6.2%、军团声望 -2.5%、势力声望约 -0.1%。

blocks.en: Gaining standings with an agent, corporation or faction can be lucrative. With higher standings, you will be able to take higher level missions, pay fewer broker fees in NPC stations and get cheaper reprocessing in NPC stations. See NPC standings for all advantages of standings. The amount of standing received is influenced by the Social skill giving 5% bonus per level to NPC agent, corporation and faction standing increase.
blocks.zh: 提升对代理人、军团或势力的声望好处很多。声望越高，你就能接更高等级的任务，在 NPC 空间站支付更少的中介费，在 NPC 空间站提炼也更划算。声望的全部好处见NPC 声望。获得的声望数量受社会学技能影响，每级使对 NPC 代理人、军团和势力的声望提升增加 5%。

blocks.en: Bounties
blocks.zh: 赏金

blocks.en: You will also receive ISK from bounties while killing NPC pirates, not empire factions. You will often get more ISK from bounties than from the mission reward. Bounties are a fixed amount per ship type so the total bounty depends on number and types of ships you destroy.
blocks.zh: 击杀 NPC 海盗（不包括帝国势力）时你还会获得赏金 ISK。赏金收入常常比任务奖励还多。每种舰船的赏金是固定的，因此总赏金取决于你击毁的舰船数量和类型。

blocks.en: Loot and salvage
blocks.zh: 拾取与打捞

blocks.en: You will also be able to loot and salvage the wrecks though it depends on the mission level and killed NPCs whether it is profitable or not. There is always a rare chance of an item of considerable value dropping as loot.
blocks.zh: 你还可以拾取残骸里的物品并打捞残骸，不过是否划算取决于任务等级和击杀的 NPC。拾取物中总有很小的几率掉落相当值钱的物品。

blocks.en: Mission related timers
blocks.zh: 任务相关计时器

blocks.en: Offer timer
blocks.zh: 邀请计时器

blocks.en: Opportunities mission card with offer timer. Identified by the orange speech balloon on the agent portrait.
blocks.zh: 带有邀请计时器的机遇任务卡片，可通过代理人头像上的橙色对话气泡识别。

blocks.en: The offer or acceptance timer starts when talking to the agent and has a duration of 6 to 7 days. When the mission is not accepted in this time frame the agent will withdraw the offer and send you a message, telling you how displeased they are:
blocks.zh: 邀请（或接受）计时器从你与代理人对话时开始，时长为 6 到 7 天。如果在此期间没有接受任务，代理人会撤回邀请，并发消息告诉你他们有多不满：

en: Mission Offer Expired I can no longer await your response to my offer. I am displeased by your indecisiveness.
zh: 任务邀请已过期 我无法再等待你对我的邀请作出答复了。你的优柔寡断令我不满。

blocks.en: Aside from this general message some missions like Carrying AIMEDs have a more flavored text:
blocks.zh: 除了这条通用消息，有些任务（如Carrying AIMEDs）还有更有故事性的文本：

en: Would you believe it? Those fools went and let ships dock with no medics to give the okay. Turns out one of 'em was carrying some kind of plague, and the whole station ended up sick before they figured out what was going on.Anyway, you don't need to take the AID parts over anymore. They'll take care of that when they refurbish the place after the hazmat team finishes sterilizing it and incinerating the bodies.
zh: 你敢信吗？ 那帮蠢货居然在没有医疗人员放行的情况下就让舰船停靠了。结果其中一艘船上带着某种瘟疫，等他们反应过来时，整个空间站都已经病倒了。总之，你不用再把那些援助物资送过去了。等防化小组消毒完毕、焚烧完尸体后，他们翻修空间站时会自己处理的。

blocks.en: Letting the offer timer expire has no consequences for your standings.
blocks.zh: 让邀请计时器过期不会影响你的声望。

blocks.en: Note: COSMOS missions are a one shot offer, so letting the offer expire means that that mission and all missions after that one are no longer available.
blocks.zh: 注意：COSMOS 任务只提供一次，因此让邀请过期意味着该任务及其后续所有任务都将无法再接取。

blocks.en: The offer timer can be found:
blocks.zh: 邀请计时器可以在以下位置查看：

en: in the Opportunities overview by hovering over the hourglass in the bottom right corner of the tile (countdown timer)
in the Opportunities mission details view (countdown timer)
in the mission journal (timestamp)
zh: 在机遇总览中，将鼠标悬停在卡片右下角的沙漏上（倒计时）
在机遇任务详情视图中（倒计时）
在任务日志中（时间戳）

blocks.en: With the Viridian expansion the mission journal was removed from the Neocom and the short-cut settings. Its keyboard short-cut was assigned to the newly introduced opportunities window.
blocks.zh: 在Viridian版本中，任务日志被从Neocom和快捷键设置中移除，原来的快捷键分配给了新加入的机遇（Opportunities）窗口。

blocks.en: Till the 2nd December 2025, the mission journal could still be called using the slash command /open journal in any of the chat windows.
blocks.zh: 在 2025 年 12 月 2 日之前，仍然可以在任意聊天窗口中用斜杠命令 /open journal 打开任务日志。

blocks.en: In the Version 23.02 release 2025-12-02.1 CCP announced: Slash commands via chat have been disabled.
blocks.zh: 在 23.02 版本 2025-12-02.1 更新中，CCP 宣布：聊天中的斜杠命令已被禁用。

blocks.en: The mission journal showing an accepted mission with the completion timer, a non expiring offered mission and an offered mission with the offer timer.
blocks.zh: 任务日志，显示一个带完成计时器的已接受任务、一个不会过期的待接任务，以及一个带邀请计时器的待接任务。

blocks.en: Completion timer
blocks.zh: 完成计时器

blocks.en: Opportunities mission card with completion timer. No speech balloon on the agent portrait.
blocks.zh: 带有完成计时器的机遇任务卡片，代理人头像上没有对话气泡。

blocks.en: The completion timer starts when accepting the mission and has a duration of 7 days. Letting the completion timer expire will cause the mission to fail. And will incur a standings penalty with the agent, corporation and faction.
blocks.zh: 完成计时器从接受任务时开始，时长为 7 天。让完成计时器过期会导致任务失败，并造成对代理人、军团和势力的声望惩罚。

blocks.en: The completion timer can be found:
blocks.zh: 完成计时器可以在以下位置查看：

en: in the Opportunities overview by hovering over the hourglass in the bottom right corner of the tile (countdown timer)
in the Opportunities mission details view (countdown timer)
in the mission journal (timestamp)
zh: 在机遇总览中，将鼠标悬停在卡片右下角的沙漏上（倒计时）
在机遇任务详情视图中（倒计时）
在任务日志中（时间戳）

blocks.en: Bonus timer
blocks.zh: 额外奖励计时器

blocks.en: The bonus timer starts with the completion timer and has a duration from 10 minutes to 6 hours. Completion of the missions within the bonus timer grants a bonus reward.
blocks.zh: 额外奖励计时器与完成计时器同时开始，时长从 10 分钟到 6 小时不等。在额外奖励计时器内完成任务可以获得额外奖励。

blocks.en: The bonus timer can be found on the right side of the Agent Conversation window in the Bonus Rewards section.
blocks.zh: 额外奖励计时器显示在代理人对话窗口右侧的“额外奖励”栏中。

blocks.en: Decline missions timer
blocks.zh: 拒绝任务计时器

blocks.en: The "Decline mission" timer tells you how long you have to wait until you can decline another mission from this agent without losing standing.
blocks.zh: “拒绝任务”计时器会告诉你还要等多久，才能在不损失声望的情况下再次拒绝这位代理人的任务。

blocks.en: The decline missions timer starts when declining a mission and has a duration of 4 hours. See § Declining missions.
blocks.zh: 拒绝任务计时器从你拒绝任务时开始，时长为 4 小时。参见 § 拒绝任务。

blocks.en: The decline timer can be found on the left side of the Agent Conversation window in the last paragraph of text.
blocks.zh: 拒绝计时器显示在代理人对话窗口左侧文字的最后一段中。

blocks.en: Declining missions
blocks.zh: 拒绝任务

blocks.en: Declining a mission for a particular agent more than once every four hours will cause a standings loss with the agent, corporation, and faction.
blocks.zh: 每四小时内对同一位代理人拒绝任务超过一次，会导致你对该代理人、军团以及势力的声望下降。

blocks.en: If an agent you recently declined a mission from offers you another undesirable mission, you can click DELAY, wait out the four hour timer while you go do something else, and then decline.
blocks.zh: 如果你刚拒绝过任务的代理人又给了你一个不想做的任务，可以点击“推迟（DELAY）”，先去做别的事情等四小时计时器结束，再回来拒绝。

blocks.en: Missioning with a fleet
blocks.zh: 组队做任务

blocks.en: Main article: Mission fleets
blocks.zh: 主条目：任务舰队

blocks.en: Members of a fleet who run missions can share all of the standings, LP, and ISK rewards from the mission and bounties automatically. Loot and/or salvage can be shared by hand. This is especially good for newer players, as they generally gain more standings than they share. There are two main kinds of mission fleet: Spider, where everyone runs their own missions, but shares standings, etc. at the end; and Locust, where the fleet members all work on the same mission together
blocks.zh: 一起做任务的舰队成员可以自动分享任务和赏金带来的全部声望、LP 和 ISK 奖励。拾取物和/或打捞物可以手动分配。这对新玩家特别有利，因为他们得到的声望通常比分出去的多。任务舰队主要有两种：蜘蛛式（Spider），每个人各做各的任务，最后再分享声望等奖励；以及蝗虫式（Locust），舰队成员一起做同一个任务

blocks.en: Advice for new mission runners
blocks.zh: 给新手任务玩家的建议

blocks.en: If you're new to mission running and your goal is to gain loot, pile up LP to buy things or to increase your standing with a faction, then you may want to lay out a plan to help you run your missions with a minimum of down time. Here are some suggestions.
blocks.zh: 如果你刚开始做任务，目标是获取拾取物、积攒 LP 买东西或提升对某个势力的声望，那么最好制定一个计划，尽量减少做任务时的空闲时间。下面是一些建议。

blocks.en: 1. Pick an area in which to work
blocks.zh: 1. 选择一个工作区域

blocks.en: The last thing you want is to be running missions in the middle of a contested low sec region where combatants will shoot at you, or in systems that lie on a busy trade route where griefers will target you. Use the map and look for a group of fairly high security systems set off from the major trade routes and other active systems. Keep in mind that you can be scanned down in mission pockets and war targets will attempt to do so.
blocks.zh: 你最不希望的就是在争夺激烈的低安星域里做任务，被交战方开火攻击，或者在繁忙的贸易路线星系里被捣乱者盯上。打开星图，找一片远离主要贸易路线和其他热闹星系、安全等级较高的星系。要记住，你在任务空间里是可以被扫描定位的，战争目标也会尝试这么做。

blocks.en: 2. Know what you want; check out what the various agents offer
blocks.zh: 2. 明确你的需求，了解各个代理人能提供什么

blocks.en: Successful mission runs give you ISK and Encounter missions can also give you loot. They also give you standing with the agent that gave you the mission, the agent's corporation, and the agent's faction. In addition, they give you LP that can be redeemed for items in the corporation's store. The corporation you gain LP for is important.
blocks.zh: 成功完成任务可以获得 ISK，遭遇战任务还能获得拾取物。任务也会提升你对发布任务的代理人、其所属军团和势力的声望。此外，还会给你 LP，可以在该军团的商店里兑换物品。所以你为哪个军团赚 LP 很重要。

blocks.en: Most corporation stores sell the same sets of augmentation implants. However, different corporations offer different sets of skill upgrade implants, and different factions offer different modules, hulls and ammunition. Roden Shipyards, for example, sells warp drive and astrometric skill upgrades, while Astral Mining offers mining upgrades. Weapons and ammunition offers correspond to the faction's spaceship preferences - Minmitar offer projectile weapons and ammo, Ammar offer laser weapons and crystals, and so on.
blocks.zh: 大多数军团商店出售同样的几套属性增强植入体。但不同军团提供的技能强化植入体各不相同，不同势力提供的装备、船体和弹药也不同。例如莱登船业出售跃迁引擎和天体测量类的技能强化植入体，而星形矿业提供采矿类强化植入体。武器和弹药则与势力偏好的舰船风格对应——米玛塔尔提供射弹武器和弹药，艾玛提供激光武器和晶体，依此类推。

blocks.en: 3. Pick a corporation with multiple agents in the region
blocks.zh: 3. 选择一个在该区域有多位代理人的军团

blocks.en: Nearly every station has at least one agent, and there are many duplications in terms of standings and items offered for sale. So if you want to improve your standing with Gallente and you want to buy equipment to improve your mining, then Astral Mining is one of the corporations you would want to consider. Since there are many Astral Mining agents in Gallente space, choosing this corporation will not restrict your choice of star systems all that much.
blocks.zh: 几乎每个空间站都至少有一位代理人，而且在声望和商店物品方面有很多重复。所以如果你想提升盖伦特声望，又想买装备来提升采矿能力，星形矿业就是值得考虑的军团之一。由于盖伦特空间里有很多星形矿业的代理人，选择这个军团并不会太限制你对星系的选择。

blocks.en: Once you have a goal in mind, use the Agent Finder to narrow your choices of star system. Keep in mind that when you finish running level 1, you will almost certainly have to move to a new system to find a level 2 agent, and again for level 3 and 4. So try to find a group of level 1-2-3-4 agents that are fairly close together.
blocks.zh: 确定目标后，用代理人查找器（Agent Finder）缩小星系范围。要记住，做完 1 级任务后，你几乎肯定要换到新星系去找 2 级代理人，3 级和 4 级也是如此。所以尽量找一组彼此相距较近的 1、2、3、4 级代理人。

blocks.en: To avoid unfavorable missions such missions in low/null security space and missions that require you to kill empire ships you will need to decline missions every now and then. It is best to choose your location so that you have a second and even third agent as backup once you can't decline the mission offered from the first agent without losing standings.
blocks.zh: 为了避开不想做的任务，比如位于低安/00 区的任务，以及要求你击杀帝国舰船的任务，你时不时需要拒绝任务。最好选一个有第二、甚至第三位备用代理人的地点，这样当第一位代理人的任务无法在不损失声望的情况下拒绝时，还有其他选择。

blocks.en: 4. Pick a base station and start running
blocks.zh: 4. 选一个基地空间站，开始做任务

blocks.en: Here is the map for that area:
blocks.zh: 下面是该区域的星图：

blocks.en: You need a base because as you go along, you will buy ships, ammunition and other gear and you will pick up loot and salvage from completed missions. It's easiest to keep all this stuff in one place, so plan to go to your agent's base to run missions, then fly back to your base when you need to resupply. It is often best to bring all the refit modules and extra ammo to the agent's station so you don't need to travel more than is needed.
blocks.zh: 你需要一个基地，因为随着进度推进，你会购买舰船、弹药和其他装备，还会从完成的任务中获得拾取物和打捞物。把这些东西都放在一个地方最方便，所以计划好去代理人那里做任务，需要补给时再飞回基地。通常最好把所有用于改装的装备和额外弹药都带到代理人所在的空间站，这样就不用多跑路。

blocks.en: Two hints for being sure your mission is complete
blocks.zh: 确认任务已完成的两个小窍门

en: Look for a green check mark next to the mission
zh: 看任务旁边是否有绿色对勾

en: If you think the mission is finished but you don't see the green checkmark or want to check your objectives, click on the little down arrow next to the mission name and select "Details" from the menu. This will show you the mission briefing and you can take another look at your objectives.
zh: 如果你认为任务已经完成，却没看到绿色对勾，或者想核对任务目标，可以点击任务名称旁的小下拉箭头，在菜单中选择“详情（Details）”。这会显示任务简报，你可以再看一遍任务目标。

blocks.en: Note that some missions may not get this completion mark.
blocks.zh: 注意，有些任务可能不会显示这个完成标记。

blocks.en: Mission preparation and walkthroughs
blocks.zh: 任务准备与攻略

blocks.en: Never fly what you cannot afford to lose applies to running missions as well. When starting, fly the cheapest ship that will do the job and only pay for expensive upgrades once you're sure you can replace them. Also, keep in mind that no activity is 100% safe, mission runners can get scanned down and ganked and even an empty transport ship can become a target for a bored ganker.
blocks.zh: “不要开你损失不起的船”这句话同样适用于做任务。刚开始时，开能完成任务的最便宜的船，只有在确定自己能补得起时再花钱升级昂贵的装备。另外要记住，没有任何活动是 100% 安全的：任务玩家可能被扫描定位并遭到自杀式攻击，就连一艘空的运输舰也可能成为无聊的自杀式攻击者的目标。

blocks.en: NPC's in missions tend to be very predictable in their setups. For example, Gallente and Serpentis use only Kinetic and Thermal damage against you and are most susceptible to Kinetic and Thermal damage themselves; when they use any form of EWAR, it's always sensor dampening. It helps quite a bit if you set up your ship to deal damage that NPCs are vulnerable to and defend against what they will throw at you. Check out NPC damage types for a full description and a handy chart that you can keep in your Neocom Notebook.
blocks.zh: 任务中的 NPC 配置往往非常好预测。例如，盖伦特和天蛇集团只会对你造成动能和热能伤害，自身也最怕动能和热能伤害；只要他们使用电子战，就一定是感应抑阻。如果你按 NPC 的弱点配置输出伤害，并针对他们的攻击做好防御，会轻松很多。完整说明见 NPC 伤害类型，那里还有一张方便的表格，可以保存在 Neocom 记事本里。

blocks.en: Notes
blocks.zh: 注释

blocks.en: References
blocks.zh: 参考资料
